gen-dafont-dogica-inter: Heavy, wide-tracked Dogica sits up top with a lowercase that nearly climbs to capital height, while Inter's sans letterforms breathe below. The smooth, tube-like line is the real draw.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One is a classic serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, set beneath the wide, playful tracking of Early GameBoy. Paragraphs would read dignified and literary, unhurried.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-kadwa: Early GameBoy stretches out with commanding, widely spaced letters and a skyward x-height, and its g has sturdy bowls. Kadwa, the serif, adds open-ended curves and editorial order below it.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-noticia-text: Literary and dignified, with a big entrance into each curve. Noticia Text does the quiet work, lowercase filling the line, while Early GameBoy handles the commanding, playful shouting up top.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-scope-one: Early GameBoy spreads commanding, playful letters wide, with modest stroke contrast you only notice up close. Scope One, the serif, adds spilling counters and stubby ascenders beside big x-height.
